description: Use this when the user wants a tender taken off their team's Winquill pipeline, for good or until a change brings it back: "remove it until it gets a value". It deletes the tender's bid call, sprint and the files the team added; for one in Bidding, Submitted, Won or Lost the answer asks first, so confirm with the user and call again with confirmed. Needs a Winquill account and workspace. Not for moving a tender to another stage (use move_in_pipeline) or a no-bid call (use record_bid_call). Example: {"tender_reference":"012345-2026","return_when":"value"}

confirmed.description: True once the user has confirmed taking off a tender with a bid under way or a result.

return_when.description: Put it back in Watching when this happens, and tell the user: "value" when the buyer publishes or changes its value, "deadline" when the deadline moves, "opens" when a pipeline notice opens for bids, "any_change" for any change to the notice. Leave out to take it off for good.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Winquill workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: remove_from_pipeline
title: Take a tender off the pipeline
